name: Syringe Pump
instruction: Could you design a 3D model of a syringe pump? It should have a base unit with a digital display and a holder for a syringe.

Shape accuracy: The object in the images is a syringe pump.
The holder for the syringe is integrated into the base unit.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The digital display is appropriately sized for readability.
The holder is proportionate to the base unit.
Texture and surface detail: The base unit has a smooth surface for easy cleaning.
The digital display may have a glass or plastic finish.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The digital display is positioned on the front of the base unit.
The holder is securely attached to the base unit.
The overall structure is stable and balanced.
Object distance and contact: There is no overlap between the digital display and the holder.
The holder is positioned at a height that allows easy access to the syringe.
The base unit provides adequate support for the holder.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified components (base unit, digital display, holder) are accurately represented.
There are no deviations from the instructions.
